### Rule
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-4f4b69b4]]#atom-technical-atom-919fa61de5e436af If you want to include small or large dogs in your game, the game master should increase or _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-05784))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-4f4b69b4]]#atom-technical-atom-6902695a63484ca0 If given a command-- the only ones who can give commands are those who directly created the monster or those who used ma _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-05805))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-4f4b69b4]]#atom-technical-atom-90b8fdba90691336 They can distinguish their master and will follow their commands (if they're trained). _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-05806))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-4f4b69b4]]#atom-technical-atom-03045526004af4ed They can also use primitive tools, words, and a very limited number of written characters. _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-05807))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-4f4b69b4]]#atom-technical-atom-9edf07f3e8794b67 A character must make a success roll using their evasion speed as the baseline score and these attack points as the targ _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-05821))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-4f4b69b4]]#atom-technical-atom-3b638462d6325491 In this case, if they're written on one line separated by a slash (/), it means that they can attack that number of time _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-05822))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-4f4b69b4]]#atom-technical-atom-36398bb7a2562edf If a character fails to evade their attack, these strike points become damage and reduce the character's life force. _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-05827))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-4f4b69b4]]#atom-technical-atom-2857819ba8a82d23 Just as characters can reduce damage through armor, monsters also have thick skin, shells, scales, etc. _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-05833))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-4f4b69b4]]#atom-technical-atom-ed1e342b3fb01f89 When struck by magic or similar attacks, defense points cannot reduce damage, monster level reduces damage instead. _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-05834))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-4f4b69b4]]#atom-technical-atom-ab94720567baa623 When a character casts a spell on a monster, they must make a success roll using their magic power as the baseline score _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-05843))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-13-2-2-fae-64100e1e]]#atom-technical-atom-d6a54e122c78fb91 They cannot wear heavy armor, only soft leather at most. _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-05895))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-13-2-3-youma-1b224e44]]#atom-technical-atom-eb164e327a82c934 They're weak against fire and heat, so when attacking a marshman with firebased magic, add +10 to strike power when maki _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-05982))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-13-2-4-spirits-fc1871d8]]#atom-technical-atom-16f8d2092f8bc449 Undine can cast magic sourced from the power of undine without consuming its own mental points (the spells cannot be exp _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-06051))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-13-2-4-spirits-fc1871d8]]#atom-technical-atom-fe357c487ea7dfa4 To do so, you must make a successful life force resistance roll. _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-06053))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-13-2-4-spirits-fc1871d8]]#atom-technical-atom-ed16b3ba461a31f0 Also, when a person using the spirit magic Water Screen is attacked by a salamander, after the normal effect, 2 points o _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-06065))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-13-2-4-spirits-fc1871d8]]#atom-technical-atom-87c69493c742bb09 Also, you cannot cast magic on mad sprites. _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-06094))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-13-2-4-spirits-fc1871d8]]#atom-technical-atom-09a88dd2d2c0e9a5 When a mad sprite performs this attack, the target must make a mental power resistance roll (target score 13). _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-06095))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-13-2-4-spirits-fc1871d8]]#atom-technical-atom-ac8a48296944f7d2 If magic cannot be cast on the target, the dryad will attack barehanded. _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-06147))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-13-2-5-titans-bc0a505c]]#atom-technical-atom-abadfb6c36c89143 Conversely, it is weak against fire, so if it's a fire-based attack, the check can be made with +10 to strike power. _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-06209))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-13-2-5-titans-bc0a505c]]#atom-technical-atom-caf74e80243d8e5a The form that a Spriggan can take after transforming is fixed for each individual (its apparent age cannot be changed ei _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-06221))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-13-2-5-titans-bc0a505c]]#atom-technical-atom-04f495d98ac7ce65 The target may not take any actions for one round and will suffer a -4 penalty to evasion. _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-06222))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-13-2-5-titans-bc0a505c]]#atom-technical-atom-70c06358d45b1b1c A spriggan can use its considerable strength even in its child form. _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-06223))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-13-2-5-titans-bc0a505c]]#atom-technical-atom-c5c878fe2b145380 Their body color is the same as a rock surface, and if you are careless, you may mistake one for a huge rock. _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-06227))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-13-2-6-mythical-beasts-and-magical-beasts-7977e270]]#atom-technical-atom-0c7d135515d03a3c By sticking with this lower body, a ceiling hanger can also move along walls and ceilings. _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-06307))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-13-2-6-mythical-beasts-and-magical-beasts-7977e270]]#atom-technical-atom-0e008c320fe0ba53 From then on, in each round, a death check must be made when applying damage (even if it's 0). _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-06310))_
- [[sword-world-rpg-complete-edition-section-monster-catalog-13-2-6-mythical-beasts-and-magical-beasts-7977e270]]#atom-technical-atom-c8bb8e705f8061a1 Also, you cannot cast magic on the medusa in these states. _(Sword World RPG - Complete Edition.pdf (source-range-e5870dca-06343))_
